snippet.title: HAPPY HEAVENLY BIRTHDAY MICHAEL JACKSON (67 TODAY)
snippet.description:
In 2025, August 29 marks the 67th anniversary of Michael Jackson's birth. He became the global king of pop music and changed the entire show business with his persona alone. Without Jackson, there would be no Taylor Swift, your Beyoncé’s etc etc concerts as we know them today, and much more.

Michael Jackson's birthday is a date that millions of people around the world celebrate with special reverence. The King of Pop left behind not only a rich creative legacy but also many secrets, legends, and myths that surround his life and even his death. Happy Heavenly Birthday Michael Jackson - you are missed so much💔🕊️

snippet.description:
HIStory Tour - Seoul 1996
Michael Jackson held two concerts in Seoul during the HIStory World Tour on October 11 and October 13, 1996, at the Olympic Stadium. The October 13th concert was recorded and released as the VHS exclusive HIStory World Tour: Live in Seoul in South Korea in 1997.
